description:
One tenth of the reproduction run, to price it. One of three files that differ only in instance_type -- c7am, c7al, c7ax -- so that what a trial costs and how long it takes are measured rather than assumed before twenty of them are launched.
Two things are being read. Throughput: this is what the reproduction ran on, so it is the number the other two are measured against, and the one the twenty-trial estimate would rest on if the cheaper queues turn out not to serve. Footprint: it has 7 GiB, so nothing here is expected to be tight.
Two epochs, which is the shape of the real run rather than a shortcut: the first pays for compilation and the second does not, so the pair separates startup from steady state. Everything else is pinned to the settings the recorded 1043.66 run used, so the work being timed is the work.
name: probe-c7ax
